text:
Eli P: Hi all, first week here. Trying to finish on-call setup. Can't see the PagerDuty 'oncall' group in Okta and not sure which runtime runbook is the canonical one. Also unclear if shadow can trigger staging failovers or only observe.
Ruth G: Welcome! Confluence runtime-oncall is the canonical doc. GitHub runbooks are snapshots for exercises. Shadowers can run staging exercises with a lead present, but not prod failovers.
Eli P: Okta shows 'group not visible' when searching for org:engineers. Tried Request but it errors.
IdP Bot: Automated request created (idp-1769003465). If auto-approval fails, IdP team will follow up.
Marco D: Pinged IdP. Eli, paste your Okta email here and I'll kick a manual sync.
Eli P: eli.parker@redwood.com
IdP Bot: Manual sync queued (sync-1769003471). Estimated completion ~90s.
Oncall Bot: Shadow rotation slots updated. Eli P assigned to oncall-shadow (start 1769007200).
Marco D: After sync I'll send PD invite with role=shadow. We'll run a low-sev test page so you can practice ack and phone escalation.
IdP Bot: Manual sync complete (sync-1769003473). Group mapping pushed to PagerDuty.
Eli P: I accepted PD invite but got 'insufficient permissions' when acknowledging test page.
Ruth G: That usually means PD role mapping didn't apply. @IdP Bot please re-sync mapping to PagerDuty.
IdP Bot: Mapping resync executed (mapping-1769003480). No errors reported.
Eli P: Ack worked. Heard phone callback and saw escalation metadata. Thanks.
Eli P: Quick question on escalation timing: runbook has ranges but some team leads prefer different windows. Which do we follow?
Marco D: Follow the Confluence matrix in the runbook for our team. We escalate 0-3m initial ack, 3-7m phone primary, 7-15m auto-escalate to infra lead, 15+m IC. If you see deviations, file a one-line note under Confluence 'recent onboardings'.
Eli P: Another question: as a shadower, am I expected to act as primary if the primary is unreachable during my slot?
Ruth G: No. Shadow role is to learn and assist; you are not primary. If primary is unreachable, the escalation policy promotes the next on-duty primary or infra lead. You'll be observed on live pages.
Eli P: Found a tiny docs issue: the staging drain example misses --dry-run in one snippet. Can I open a PR?
Marco D: Yes please. Tag [onboarding-docs] and well merge quickly.
Eli P: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/578 - fixes drain example and adds a short note about Okta visibility.
Oncall Bot: Pull request referenced in thread: #578.
Ruth G: Nice. Also schedule a 10-min phone drill with me after youre added to PD so you can verify voice flow.
Eli P: Thanks everyone. I'll join the shadow kickoff tomorrow 09:30 and file the Confluence note after shadow week. Appreciate the help! :thumbsup:
